card.name: Digits inside numbers before units
card.fires_on: A single digit within a multi-digit number or decimal, such as the 2 in 0.2% or the 3 in 3/4-inch, in dosing, percentages, and needle sizes. It is usually followed by a percent sign, a unit, or a slash.

modes.label: Decimal or second digit of a percentage
modes.description: A digit completing a percentage, often in a list of rates or a concentration.

modes.label: Needle and syringe sizes
modes.description: A digit starting a gauge or fraction-of-inch needle size.
